items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mary Riece Europe was one our teachers, this is Jim Europe’s sister… taught at Dunbar High School.

ctx.x: So the same time that you were learning how to play jazz/popular music from the practitioners, were you also learning traditional theory and harmony practices in school?

Yes. I was… with Henry Grant and with other music teachers… Mary Riece Europe was one our teachers, this is Jim Europe’s sister… taught at Dunbar High School. She and Henry Grant were personally responsible for many of the great artists

that came to our schools and for really directing our attention… she was kind of the vocal person in the music instruction there. She was the vocal music teacher, he was the instrumental music teacher so we had both in our high school. So you could sing in her choir and/or you could play in his orchestra. They were very big on harmony and theory. You had to know what you were singing or playing.
